messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023** (i.e., holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, or are observed on a Monday when they land on a weekend).  These are the dates that will give you a three‑day break (Friday‑Sunday) or a four‑day break (Thursday‑Sunday) depending on the weekend:

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Observed (if weekend) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|--------------|-----------------------|-------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 | **Jan 1–3** (Fri‑Sun) |
| **Family Day** (Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Monday Feb 20 | – | **Feb 18–20** (Fri‑Sun) |
| **Good Friday** | Friday Apr 7 | – | **Apr 7–9** (Fri‑Sun) |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | – | **May 20–22** (Fri‑Sun) |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 | **Jul 1–3** (Fri‑Sun) |
| **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | – | **Sep 2–4** (Fri‑Sun) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | – | **Oct 7–9** (Fri‑Sun) |
| **Remembrance Day** | Saturday Nov 11 | Monday Nov 13 | **Nov 11–13** (Fri‑Sun) |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday Dec 25 | – | **Dec 23–25** (Fri‑Sun) |

> **Notes**  
> * **Boxing Day** (Dec 26) falls on a Tuesday, so it does **not** create a long weekend.  
> * Some provinces have additional holidays that can also create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. Joseph’s Day in Quebec, etc.). If you need province‑specific long weekends, let me know which provinces you’re interested in.  

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app!
